propertyTaxRate.note: unverified. No primary or Census ACS effective-rate figure for Puerto Rico was obtainable (Tax Foundation Table 2 covers states + DC only; the Census API requires a key). CRIM rates are municipal (roughly 8-12% of 1958-basis appraised value), so 'effective rate on market value' is structurally low; keep 0.008 flagged as an estimate.

programs.name: Veteran Exemption

tiers[0] ($5,000, all veterans).quote: Estará exenta de la imposición y pago de contribuciones sobre la propiedad, permanentemente y hasta cinco mil (5,000) dólares ... de su valor de tasación para fines contributivos, la vivienda que un veterano y/o cónyuges supérstites edificare o adquiriere de buena fe para residencia principal
tiers[0] ($5,000, all veterans).note: The $50,000 enhanced amount applied only to fiscal years 2009-10 through 2018-19 and has lapsed.

tiers[1] ($50,000 at 50%+).quote: Todo veterano que reciba compensación por conducto de la Administración de Veteranos (Veterans Affairs Department) por incapacidad de un cincuenta por ciento (50%) o más tendrá derecho a una exención de contribución sobre la propiedad sobre los primeros cincuenta mil (50,000) dólares
tiers[1] ($50,000 at 50%+).note: The $500,000 enhanced amount applied only to FY2009-10 through 2018-19. Granted 'en adición a la exención corriente de cinco mil (5,000) dólares', so the two tiers stack ($55,000 total at 50%+). Rating tested as of Jan 1 each year; one-time filing if VA certifies the grade as permanent.

tiers[2] ('full' at 100%).correct: Full exemption is for a 'veterano incapacitado o impedido' documented by an SSA or Commonwealth/U.S. retirement-system disability determination, not by a 100% VA rating
tiers[2] ('full' at 100%).quote: Se exime totalmente del pago de contribuciones sobre la propiedad toda casa construida, adquirida o remodelada ... por un veterano incapacitado o impedido y el solar donde enclava la misma hasta un máximo de mil (1000) metros cuadrados en zonas urbanas o de una cuerda en zonas rurales
tiers[2] ('full' at 100%).note: AS-38 document list for this tier: 'Determinación de incapacidad de la Administración del Seguro Social o Sistemas de Retiro del ELA o EUA.' Resolves the brief's lead: relabel the top tier as disabled/impaired veteran (SSA or retirement disability determination); a 100% VA rating alone is not the statutory key, though most 100% P&T veterans with SSDI will meet it.

survivingSpouse.quote: (a) Exención aplicable a todos los veteranos y/o a sus cónyuges supérstites
survivingSpouse.note: The 50%+ tier text also covers 'la vivienda que un veterano y/o cónyuge supérstite edificare o adquiere'; AS-38 lists 'Los veteranos y/o sus cónyuges supérstites (viudo/a)' for the regular tier and requires a death certificate. Art. 6 continues benefits to the surviving spouse until remarriage.

ratingRequired.quote: Exención aplicable a todos los veteranos

programs.effectiveChanges: None for FY2026-27. OGP consolidated text revised 3 Aug 2026 (amendments through Ley 145-2026) shows the same $5,000 / $50,000 / total structure; the enhanced FY2009-2019 amounts remain lapsed.
programs.note: Values are on CRIM 'valor de tasación' (1958-basis appraisal), so the dollar tiers translate into modest but real savings; the lot limit for the disabled tiers is 1,000 m2 urban / one cuerda rural.

jurisdictionNote.note: No propertyTax.note in the file for PR.

CRIM Modelo AS-38 Exoneración Contributiva / Veteranos (Rev. Abril 2018) with document checklist

summary: Puerto Rico's three tiers ($5,000 for all veterans and surviving spouses, +$50,000 at 50%+ VA compensation, full exemption for an 'incapacitado o impedido' veteran) are confirmed in the Aug 2026 OGP text, but the full tier is keyed to an SSA/retirement disability determination, not a 100% VA rating, and survivingSpouse should be true. The 0.8% effective rate could not be sourced and stays unverified.
